evidence: Frozen task/task.toml [environment]: build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096 - identical to the template's [environment] block (rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml). No docker_image key and no allow_internet key anywhere in task.toml (grep returned nothing). [environment] holds no secret literal; the only credential-shaped lines in task.toml are in [verifier.env] (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" template and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""), which are the frozen expected block, not literals. [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public" is per profile. task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template Dockerfile (diff empty): pinned node:22-bookworm-slim base, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 preinstalled globally with NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules, COPY instructions/ and assets/, chmod a+rX, /app git-initialised; no ENV/ARG secret, no COPY of solution/ or tests/. The image holds nothing that secretly needs an install: integration.md:3-5 limits the app to Express, better-sqlite3 and Node built-ins, which are exactly what the image preinstalls. Secret scan of environment/ (api key, secret, token, sk-, ghp_, bearer, AKIA patterns): only hit is hireops_rules.md:11, the documented shared demo password 'Hireops!2026', which the skill lists as an intentional demo credential (Known false positives), not an agent-image secret; seed_data.json had no password/secret/token/key matches and environment/ contains no http(s) URLs. 2 CPUs / 4096 MB is sane for one Node 22 Express + better-sqlite3 process with no build step. Colderwater lessons checked: none of lessons 1-21 (brief/hidden requirements, weights, gates, judge prompts, public addresses in judge prompts [row 25], timing races, restart checks, double grading) touches agent CPU/memory, secrets or network mode; lesson 13's 'local addresses only' applies to judge prompts, not to the agent network posture, so no instance bears on this row. Adversarial check: a broken app cannot pass or fail differently because of this row's settings (they are template-controlled and identical to the template); a conforming app using CDN assets is allowed by public network and integration.md:12-13, so the posture does not fail it. No cold-build measurement of the agent image was made in this round, but the row is a static configuration check and the Dockerfile is the unchanged template image; build adequacy belongs to rows 11/15.
